title: Incremental field-cube search with unequal half radii

claims.statement: For the explicit systematic field-cube code u -> (u,u^3) over the binary field with modulus X^1000+X^53+X^45+X^34+1, using the two-sided candidate decoder with systematic radius 112 and parity radius 109 in proof.md with numerical ties, the average block error on uniform 1000-bit messages over 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 55176594175514213/1000000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same field-cube code and two-sided decoder uses at most the integer W=2441*(sum of binom(1000,i) for i=0 through 112)+407503*(sum of binom(1000,i) for i=0 through 109)+28313 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(4105/8).

experiments.purpose: Verify field irreducibility, the exact nonlinear occupancy bound, inverse cubing, arithmetic sample identities for incremental cubing and the six-bit multiplication window, and exact memory and exponent limits.
